author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
what_this_is: correcting the realised-turn measurement so its event semantics apply to continuously curved executed trajectories rather than only piecewise-linear planned paths
what_this_is_NOT: changing G10 so a trajectory passes

motivating_finding.name: PREDICTED_AND_REALISED_TURN_SEMANTICS_NONCOMMENSURATE
motivating_finding.cause: the v1 rule closes a turn episode only at an essentially straight segment. That separator assumption holds for a piecewise-linear plan and fails for a pure-pursuit execution that never travels exactly straight.
not_concluded: G10 is wrong because a trajectory failed

two_stage_contract.G10_PLAN_PRECONDITION: before collection, the planned route must contain >= 3 qualifying turn events
two_stage_contract.G10_REALIZED_POSTCONDITION: after collection, the recorded trajectory must contain >= 3 DISTINCT realised turn events
two_stage_contract.principle: planned route quality is not executed trajectory quality; training-data quality is judged from what was recorded, not what the planner intended

realised_turn_definition.signal: position [T,2] -> arc-length resample -> local path TANGENT -> unwrapped heading change
realised_turn_definition.yaw_role: recorded as a separate corroborative viewpoint metric; NEVER substituted for the path tangent, because a mecanum base can translate and yaw independently
realised_turn_definition.episode: a maximal contiguous run of turning segments, bounded by a sign reversal or by a low-curvature separator run
realised_turn_definition.magnitude: NET signed heading change within the episode
realised_turn_definition.why_not_cumulative_absolute: small oscillations, tracking noise and left-right corrections would accumulate into a turn that never happened
realised_turn_definition.one_arc_is_one_event: a continuous 172 degree sweep is ONE turn, not floor(172/30); partitioning an arc would make the requirement satisfiable by any sufficiently long bend

qualifying_turn_deg.provenance: UNCHANGED; this amendment does not move it

min_separator_distance_m.provenance: THE ONLY NEW PARAMETER. Two resample intervals, so a separator is a RUN rather than a single sample. Derived from the resample interval alone and justified without reference to any collected trajectory.

exclusion_of_outcome_exposed_data.proof: every control fixture is analytic -- straight lines, constant-curvature arcs, polylines and synthetic noise, constructed in tests/test_turn_events_v2.py. No parameter is a function of any recorded trajectory. run_00000 is evaluated only AFTER this freeze, as a locked retrospective diagnostic.
exclusion_of_outcome_exposed_data.will_not_be_promoted: run_00000 is not promoted to the primary preregistered BO-10 trajectory whatever its retrospective result, because its failure was inspected before the metric changed and admitting it afterwards would be post-hoc admission.

J_three_planned_corners_blended_into_one.why_it_matters: proves the realised postcondition is not merely reproducing the planned count

harness_defect_found_while_building_the_.what: the synthetic arc helper negated both the swept angle and the lateral offset for a right-hand arc, so the path ran backwards in x and join() rotated it ~180 degrees, producing a C-curve with no sign reversal
harness_defect_found_while_building_the_.consequence: the S-curve control could never have passed and read as a metric failure
harness_defect_found_while_building_the_.direction: toward false failure, like four of the five earlier harness defects
harness_defect_found_while_building_the_.repair: only the lateral offset changes sign; the angle always advances

preserved_unchanged: magnitude of each qualifying turn >= 30 degrees
historical_g10_evidence: NOT overwritten; v1 results remain as recorded
